items.name: hermes-server
items.title: Hermes API Server Foundation
items.description: Single server-only @burner-io/hermes connection to the private Hermes API Server.
items.author: Tarek Bachir
items.docs: The browser never talks to Hermes. HERMES_URL and HERMES_API_KEY are server-only. The same API Server exposes its stable /v1/*, selected /api/* and /health/* machine-facing surfaces.

items.name: hermes-access
items.title: Hermes Application Access Guard
items.description: Application-owned authorization seam in front of Hermes route handlers.
items.author: Tarek Bachir
items.docs: This block intentionally does not own authentication. The consuming application must expose @/lib/app-user with getAppUser() and an AppUser carrying id, optional role and optional demo. Replace the policy if your app uses a different authorization model.

items.name: hermes-api
items.title: Hermes API Server BFF Routes
items.description: Explicit Next.js Route Handlers over the stable Hermes API Server surface.
items.author: Tarek Bachir
items.docs: No generic Hermes proxy is installed. The base registry deliberately exposes only health/capabilities, model inventory, skills/toolsets, sessions and Runs. Add another route only when it is part of the API Server contract you intend to expose.

items.name: hermes-query
items.title: Hermes React Query Client
items.description: Typed browser facade, TanStack Query provider and hooks for the bounded Hermes BFF.
items.author: Tarek Bachir
